reason: The README clearly presents this plugin as a workflow for converting topics and source files into editable PowerPoint presentations, with theme selection, local browser review, revisions, and explicit PPTX export.

summaries.zh: 将主题、文档、表格、图像或现有演示文稿转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 幻灯片，并提供主题选择、本地预览和导出流程。
summaries.en: Create or restyle editable PowerPoint presentations from topics and source files with theme selection, local browser review, and explicit PPTX export.

capabilities: Reads user-provided documents, spreadsheets, images, and existing presentations for deck creation or restyling
Provides local browser-based slide previews and review workflows
Supports installation and execution through an agent skill, CLI, and DeepSeek Harness bundle
